title: senecio lingianus
intro: Senecio lingianus, commonly known as Lingian Senecio, is a plant species within the daisy family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help in reducing fever, relieving pain, and treating various infections. The therapeutic actions of Senecio lingianus involve its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit anti-inflammatory effects, and show potential in treating certain types of cancer. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
